newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India GDRs extend gains in choppy trade.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India GDRs extend gains in choppy trade.

text.p: Indian global depository receipts (GDRs) maintained their post-budget jubilation on Monday, extending their gains despite profit-taking during a volatile trading session, dealers said.

"The only thing going on was India," said one trader here. "The market was all over the place -- early profit-taking, then cheap buying around lunchtime and at the end of the day there was profit taking again. People were just locking it in."
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 4.06 points, or 5.61 percent, higher at 76.45 points, with the premium over the local market at 14.75 percent compared with Friday's 14.82 percent.
Indian GDRs shot up 6.07 percent on Friday after Finance Minister P. Chidambaram announced a market-thrilling 1997/98 budget that spread euphoria across local trading floors.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index ended at 3,871.05 on Monday after shooting above 4,000 during the session. Profit-taking peeled off the market's early gains.
Among the day's best performers were Bjaj Autos, up $2.25 at $38.75, Reliance, up 95 cents at $18, and Larsen and Toubro, up 97 cents at $15.10, the trader said.
Elsewhere the GDR market put in a more modest performance. The Capel Korea GDR Index ended up 0.33 percent at 58.28, with a premium of 34.37 percent over the underlying market.

The Korea composite index ended 3.11 points higher at 679.64 but trading was slow. Players kept to the sidelines awaiting news of the appointment of a new prime minister later on Monday or early on Tuesday, dealers said.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index shed 0.90 percent to end at 102.16. The premium over the local market was 0.87 percent.

The Taiwan Weighted Index tumbled 1.29 percent to end at 7,880.45 points after the central bank warned on Saturday that investors should act cautiously amid a rally which has seen the market climb more than 1,000 points over the first two months of the year.
